title: Endpoint PowerShell Deployment & Patch Automation Toolkit
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (automation toolkit spanning Intune/Graph + PowerShell deployment and patch tasks; conditional logic, scheduled runs).
hook: Replace manual endpoint chores with tested, repeatable PowerShell automation
problem: Endpoint engineers lose hours to the same manual tasks — remediating drifted settings, confirming patch state, deploying or removing software, cleaning up after failed installs — done by hand, differently, every time. This solution gives you a tested PowerShell automation toolkit for endpoint deployment and patching: standardized, parameterized scripts and Intune remediations (proactive remediations) that run on a schedule, report results, and make every device converge to the same known-good state.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the automation model (Intune remediations / proactive remediations + Microsoft Graph + scheduled local scripts), the detect-then-remediate pattern, safe-by-default design, and how results are reported.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, the remediations feature/licensing, Microsoft Graph permissions, PowerShell execution policy/signing, a results destination) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: stand up the toolkit, deploy a detect/remediate pair as an Intune remediation, schedule patch-state checks, wire deployment/cleanup automation, capture results, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — an environment/automation-readiness discovery, a detection/validation script, a fleet automation-results report, a safe remediation script (-WhatIf default), and a deployment/cleanup runner.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A tested PowerShell automation toolkit for endpoint deployment and patching — parameterized scripts and Intune remediations that run on a schedule, report results, and converge every device to a known-good state. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
